summary: This Form 6-K filing by LEIFRAS Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, furnishes unaudited interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion, an investor presentation, and a press release. It is a routine periodic report providing quarterly financial results and operational updates. No special situation—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change—is disclosed. The filing is purely a standard earnings update with no transformative corporate event. Consequently, the filing is classified as None.
